_comment: Character/place names for John Wick (2014). English audio, English narration. names[] is the linter allow-list (character + place/org nouns the narration uses + channel brand). Whisper 'small' garbled proper nouns badly - trust FRAMES over transcript spelling. Drift seen in transcript.json: Iosef->Joseph/Yosef/Yusuf; Viggo->Vigo; Aurelio->Relio; Ms. Perkins->Bergens; Continental intact; Marcus/Winston/Harry intact.

roles.John Wick: the protagonist; a legendary retired hitman ('Baba Yaga'/the Boogeyman) who left the life for his wife Helen; pulled back into it when Iosef kills his puppy and steals his car
roles.Iosef Tarasov: Viggo's reckless son; steals John's Mustang and kills his puppy Daisy - the inciting act
roles.Viggo Tarasov: Russian crime boss; Iosef's father; John's former employer; puts a bounty on John and becomes the final antagonist
roles.Marcus: an older assassin and John's old friend; takes Viggo's contract but secretly watches over John instead; killed for it
roles.Winston: proprietor of the Continental, the assassins' hotel; keeper of the code / the gold-coin economy
roles.Ms. Perkins: an assassin who breaks Continental rules to hunt John; kills Marcus; executed by the house for the violation
roles.Aurelio: chop-shop owner who recognizes John's stolen car and refuses the job, punching Iosef
roles.Harry: an assassin at the Continental John hires to guard a captive
roles.Helen: John's late wife; dies of illness before the film's events; sends John the puppy Daisy as a final gift
